<p class="bms-glossary-term-name">Own the Cube</p>
<p class="bms-glossary-aliases"><strong>Also called:</strong> <span id="alias-control-of-the-cube">Control of the Cube</span>, <span id="alias-cube-ownership">Cube Ownership</span>, <span id="alias-owner-of-the-cube">Owner of the Cube</span>, <span id="alias-possession-of-the-doubling-cube">Possession of the Doubling Cube</span></p>
<p class="bms-glossary-definition">Own the Cube means to have accepted the last double and therefore hold the exclusive right to redouble. The term gives players a shared way to talk about this part of the game.</p>
<p class="bms-glossary-category"><strong>Glossary category:</strong> <a href="/learn/glossary/?category=cube%20and%20scoring#term-own-the-cube">Cube and Scoring</a></p>
